entries.en: *sigh* I must be really unlucky. This is[n]so depressing...
Why do you keep bothering me? What[n]are you, a stalker?
Owww. This day really has been awful...
So? What's this all about? Are you gonna[n]give it to me?
If that's the plan, well, you better make[n]sure I'm satisfied.
Don't toy with me.
You're not making sense.
What would you like?
Oh? Not giving me anything? That's too[n]bad. I was really looking forward to it.
...You're the one just standing there,[n]posing with a gun. Aren't you the one[n]toying with me?
When a man yells like that, he just looks[n]pathetic.
Oh, are you angry? Then again, you[n]haven't shot me yet. Does that mean[n]you want to chat?
Oh, please. I was just being a little sarcastic.[n]Do keep that in mind, will you?
What a coincidence. None of this is[n]making sense to me, either. Why's a little[n]boy like you pointing that thing at me?
Why don't you look it up online?[n]"How do I satisfy a woman?"[n]I'm sure it'll be handy.
Do I really need to explain every little[n]thing to you? Ah, talking to a kid is[n]pretty tiring...
What was that? Oh please, did you think[n]I was serious? *giggle* Isn't that cute?
I'm not too picky. Something that isn't[n]as dangerous as that gun you're holding[n]would be nice.
Um, I was just being sarcastic. You need[n]to look a bit deeper to get what a woman[n]means, you know.
Huh? As if you could buy what I want[n]with your allowance.
*giggle* Are you trying to look like a[n]man, little boy? You don't like being[n]talked down to, do you?
Wow, boys today are pretty wild, aren't[n]they?
...Oh, I can already tell you'll be a[n]domineering husband. I hate men like[n]that.
Now why did you do that all of a sudden?[n]Is talking not your thing? That's pretty[n]sad...
Look, let's just say that I was in the[n]wrong, all right? So won't you calm[n]down already?
You know, if you're willing to let this go...[n]I'll make it worth your while.
Worth my while?
No, thanks.
I already get enough, actually.
Yes, that's right. Something so good,[n]you've never felt anything like it...
Oh, interested? You are a boy after all.[n]But you'll have to put away that gun if[n]you want your treat.
Hm? You look like you're expecting[n]something.
Oh please, that was obviously a joke.[n]You and me? We're not a very good match.[n]Trust me.
Oh? It's adorable, how you're trying to[n]look so tough. Makes me feel a little[n]sadistic...
Ugh, I hate impertinent men. Especially[n]those who feel entitled to an opinion[n]on every matter.
You're scared, aren't you? I suppose you[n]can't help but to refuse me...
*giggle* Just what were you imagining?[n]All I said was "worth your while."
You say that, but I don't get that vibe[n]from you. Are you all talk?
You're very wise, for a child. It makes[n]the sadist in me want to crush that[n]confidence...
You think numbers are everything?[n]Are you actually pleasing your partner?
Oh, is that so? I think we'll both enjoy[n]this, then.
Ah, you angry? I guess you don't like[n]talking about this sort of thing.
You shy? Oh, that's fine. I was being[n]bad, anyway.
...Huh. I thought I made myself easy[n]enough to understand. You're pretty[n]dull, you know that, kid?
I have never been rejected before,[n]not like this!
*giggle* I guess I let my guard down.[n]Can you blame me? I didn't expect you[n]to be so strong...
So? What's going to happen to me now?
You'll be killed.
What do you want to happen?
It's a secret.
...You couldn't think of a more clever[n]reply? Maybe I have the advantage here[n]after all.
So you're just going to snuff me out?[n]I guess it's not so bad if a kid like you[n]does the snuffing.
...You think saying something like[n]that makes you look cool? Guys who[n]are all talk aren't attractive.
...Really? You'll kill me, huh? I do sort[n]of like the way you say it. Simple and[n]straight to the point.
*giggle* That's up to you. Now that[n]you're in this deep, I'll be upset if you[n]don't go all the way.
...Did you really do all this without a plan?[n]Do I really have to take the lead here?
Maybe you're trying to be nice by[n]asking me what I want, but you[n]actually just look wishy-washy.
What? Is that your idea of a tease?[n]Give it up, kid, that's not going to work.
...That just means you haven't thought[n]about it, right? Don't act all important.[n]That's not cute.
What, is it supposed to be a surprise?[n]Okay, I won't spoil it, then.
Come on, just tell me without being a[n]jerk. I won't do anything, so come closer[n]and tell me, okay?
Well, I'm sure I could guess, but...[n]Ugh, this is like dealing with flirty[n]older men at bars...
Ah, so that's it. You can't make it easier[n]to understand that that. You know what?[n]I like your style.
Well, that made me jump... At least[n]you're not boring.
...What are you aiming at? If you're going[n]to kill me, then just do it already.
...Do you get off on tormenting people?[n]Sorry, but you won't get the reaction[n]you want from me.
...If I knew this was going to happen,[n]it would have been nice if I learned[n]to cook better, huh?
You know, if I were to whip something[n]up for you, what would you want?
Meat and potatoes.
I don't need homemade food.
Can you actually cook?
...You've got some mature taste, for[n]a kid. Well, most men like meat and[n]potatoes, don't they?
Since we'd be eating together, you[n]should ask for something that pairs[n]well with wine.
Meat and potatoes? Your mom used[n]to make that or something? This[n]better not be an Oedipus complex.
What? That'll take too long, and it's too[n]much trouble. It's not like we're dating[n]or anything.
Are you saying... you won't eat my[n]cooking...?
*giggle* Am I taking things too fast by[n]offering to cook for you? It's okay, we'll[n]do something else.
...Hey, just think for second, okay?[n]Why would someone you're about to[n]kill cook you a nice homemade meal?
Well, I was just suggesting it. I'm usually[n]pretty happy to go out to eat, too.
Ah, you think I don't know how to[n]cook because I'm so beautiful, huh?[n]Well, looks can be deceiving.
...Are you making fun of me? How about[n]I just grab your stomach and crush it?
Well, I can't make anything too fancy,[n]but I can make blood-red tomato sauce[n]from scratch.
You don't think I can cook? Fine, then[n]I'll make a dish with you as the main[n]ingredient!
Happy about getting to eat my cooking,[n]huh? *giggle* All right, but you're doing[n]the dishes, okay?
I see now. You're at that age where you[n]still live with your parents. Then... want[n]to come to my place?
Ugh, judging from your mindless[n]reaction, you probably would have[n]been fine with anything I made...
...Ugh, I hope you eat a bunch of junk[n]food, and then you regret it whenever[n]you weigh yourself!
...I'm just putting this out there, but[n]you wouldn't treat me this way if I[n]were younger, right?
It's true, isn't it?
It's not true.
Maybe.
Cougars are all the rage now.
*giggle* Did I make you say that? That's[n]all I've been complaining about lately...
You must say that to all the girls. You're[n]the type who'll just say anything, aren't[n]you?
Let me get this straight. You're saying[n]you'll kill anyone, young or old, right?
...If you want to be kind to me, then[n]there's no better way than dropping[n]that gun, you know.
Aww... So you do discriminate by age,[n]after all...
But you don't even know my age. What's[n]worse is, I bet you don't even care.
The thing is, I don't think I could lose[n]to anyone else my age.
Then I'm just going to use the age[n]difference to my advantage!
Oh, I know that. I think men in general[n]are tired and looking for comfort.
Am I supposed to be happy about that?[n]Well, I do kind of like the extra attention.
...Are you sure that's not specific to a[n]particular industry?
Um, I'm not that old yet...
Don't like talking? You won't go very[n]far if you can't even make small talk.
So I hit the bullseye? *giggle* Sorry, but[n]I can see right through you.
You won't even talk to me before you[n]kill me? You can't just take a life so[n]frivolously, you know.
We can't even agree to talk about the[n]same topic. So you didn't kill me, and[n]you're not talking...
...Hey, there's no need for all this, right?[n]Let's drop the drama and just go get[n]something to eat.
The thought has crossed your mind,[n]hasn't it? Come on, where would you[n]take me?
An expensive French restaurant.
A busy ramen joint.
Where would you like to go?
Really? Your allowance can cover that?[n]Er, I do appreciate the sentiment.
Is that okay? Those sort of places have[n]dress codes, and I don't think your outfit[n]would pass.
Oh, I'm sick of going to those places.[n]Especially with old guys who think[n]that'll make a woman happy.
Doesn't French cuisine use a lot of[n]butter? I'd feel really guilty if I ate at[n]a place like that.
That might be good. It takes a lot of[n]courage for a girl to go in a place like[n]that by herself.
Then, let's go to a place with[n]tsukemen. I hate when I get all[n]sweaty and my make-up runs.
Looks like you're just trying to get this[n]done on the cheap. Even other guys[n]hate cheapskates.
Sure, but I do worry about the fat and[n]salt content... I always feel guilty after[n]eating things like that.
Ugh, you're obviously not even trying[n]to think. People aren't going to like you[n]if you keep doing that.
I was trying to gauge if you could actually[n]handle escorting a mature woman like[n]me, but it doesn't look like it.
How about some place where I'm free[n]to take photos and brag about it to my[n]friends?
Hmmm... I know a great place in Hell[n]where we can drink fresh blood as wine.
Can't even be bothered to talk, huh?[n]Well, I suppose it's unfair to expect[n]that from a kid...
So... You don't want to grab a bite to eat[n]with me? You must really hate me, huh?[n]*giggle*
I get that you're tense, but you acting on[n]basic instinct is just making me feel tense[n]too.
I was obviously joking, okay? Why would[n]I ask out a kid who can't even drink yet?
...Um, hey, you're still a student, right?
So... You enjoy teasing older women[n]like this?
That wasn't my intention.
It is fun, actually.
I'm being serious.
Ew, did you think I was serious? I[n]wonder who's teasing who? *giggle*
Then can you explain why I find myself[n]so vexed?
If that's true, then why are you even[n]pointing that thing at me, huh? What's[n]wrong with you, kid?
If you joke around too much, I might[n]take your words seriously. *giggle*
You think love's just a game? You're[n]going to have a rough time with girls[n]with that mindset.
Yeah? You better stick to casual[n]dating, kid. Screwing up a serious[n]commitment can be painful...
Hey, that doesn't mean a thing if your[n]partner isn't having fun too, kid.
Trying to look cooler than you really are[n]isn't cute. You don't even know how to[n]please a lady.
Kids always overdo things. And it's tiring[n]every time I have to deal with it.
...You don't have to reply so seriously[n]to a joke. Being with you has grown[n]tiresome...
Even if you're just saying that, it made[n]me happy. I'm sorry for making you[n]play along.
Then I'll take this seriously, under the[n]condition that we're to be married...[n]I am only joking.
...Can't you take a joke? I guess you feel[n]that no matter what, this is a battlefield...
I can't mess around with you, can I?[n]You're pretty down-to-earth for a kid.
Opening fire without a direct answer[n]to what I asked? I guess I'm still being[n]teased, here.
Why have such a cute mouth if you[n]won't use it? Perhaps I should wipe it[n]off your face.
...Is this okay? You standing here, being[n]so close to me?
Wouldn't your girlfriend get jealous if[n]she could see us?
No need to worry.
It's only bad if we get caught.
I don't have a girlfriend.
You really trust each other like that?[n]That makes me a little jealous. *giggle*
What's that supposed to mean? She[n]won't get the wrong idea if you're with[n]an old hag like me?
Yeah? And how do you know your[n]girlfriend isn't meeting someone[n]while you aren't watching her?
Huh. She must be really into you,[n]then. You're really lucky to have[n]found someone like her.
Are you asking me to just go along with[n]this? *giggle* I don't have a problem with[n]that, actually.
Yeah. I guess what she doesn't know[n]can't hurt her.
Shamelessly hiding the truth to keep up[n]appearances... You're just like a sleazy[n]politician.
*giggle* In that case, I'm gonna have[n]to get out of this alive so I can go tattle[n]to your girlfriend.
Maybe you're not being proactive[n]enough. Which is surprising, when[n]you've got enough guts to do this to me.
Oh, you didn't even need to tell me. It's[n]so obvious. Why would any lady want to[n]be with you, anyway?
Oh... Well, no worries. There are lots[n]of guys in their 30s who don't have[n]girlfriends.
Well, no need to force it. When you're[n]single, all your time and money is yours,[n]you know?
You get frustrated when you don't get[n]what you want? *giggle* You can come[n]closer, you know.
Hm? Aren't you just acting defensive? I[n]know it's hard to admit you're enchanted[n]by me...
I bet you've never been in a good[n]relationship. You should be scolded[n]for your attitude.
Did I hit a nerve? Well, no good man[n]lashes out like that because of his[n]feelings, you know.
...Okay, I understand your feelings.
I lost. Here I lay, at your feet, at your[n]mercy. Just what do you want from me?
Give me something.
Grovel before me.
I don't know.
Eh, why not? Finding something to give[n]you might be a good way to kill some[n]time.
You're pretty direct about what you[n]want, aren't you? I like that. *giggle*
Of course. Take from whoever has it,[n]right?
Give you something? You're being kind[n]of vague, aren't you?
I don't think so. Seriously, would there[n]really be any point to that?
Well, I could do that, but wouldn't[n]that just make things really awkward[n]between us?
That's not happening. I'm wearing my[n]favorite outfit today, and I'm not letting[n]it get dirty.
What? Do you think heads are for[n]hanging?
...Huh? You're not sure what you want[n]from me, either?
*giggle* Don't you know what to do in[n]this situation?
...Uh-oh. I'm starting to think what you[n]want might not be what I think it is...
Ugh. I can see this is going to take a[n]while.
I see now. You're a kid who just wants[n]to feel like he has a sense of control.
Were you expecting me to read your[n]mind? Hmm.
I thought we were having some kind of[n]talk or negotiation, but I guess I was[n]wrong.
You're such a cruel, troublesome kid.
I should hate being in this situation,[n]but somehow, it's not all that bad.
The way you treat me, though, is giving[n]me mixed messages. How do you really[n]feel about me?
You're beautiful.
You're scary.
Nothing in particular.
...It might be cliché, but hearing those[n]words makes me happy.
Maybe your approach was a bit too[n]aggressive, but I'll give you points for[n]originality.
If you're going to flatter someone, at[n]least try to do it in style.
Oh? Maybe that's what you say, but[n]I know that's not really what you're[n]thinking...
Scary, huh? I guess it's no wonder that[n]you hate me...
You think I'm scary? I'm actually known[n]to be quite therapeutic.
Hey, don't go around spreading rumors[n]like that, okay?
*giggle* I suppose anyone can be scary[n]until you really get to know them...[n]Right?
So this is how you kill time? Provoking[n]someone you have no discernible[n]feelings for? Hmph.
It kind of makes me sad to hear you say[n]that. You're so cold.
Huh. From the way you talk, you're[n]better off in casual, no strings[n]attached relationships, huh?
Wow, you don't really think about[n]other people's feelings before you[n]talk, huh?
Oh? Am I just a target to kill?
I guess most men express how they feel[n]through attitude rather than words. It's[n]not a bad thing.
You don't know how to handle someone[n]with a condescending tone. Am I right?
You really don't get how conversations[n]are supposed to work, do you, kid?
You know, the time I've spent talking[n]with you hasn't really been all that bad.
I wonder how things might have been[n]between us if circumstances were[n]different somehow.
We wouldn't have been enemies.
We'd have gotten married.
Nothing would've changed.
Hearing that makes me happy...
Sounds like I'm doomed to die now.
Just dating? Anything more than that[n]would just be inconvenient to you, huh?
Not enemies... but not friends, either?
You can't go around talking lightly[n]about marriage with a lady like me.
*giggle* You're thinking of marriage? At[n]least graduate high school first, okay?
You know, it's never fair to just drop[n]marriage on someone.
You know, I've already outgrown that[n]fantasy of getting married and living[n]happily ever after.
Yeah, I guess you're right. I was silly to[n]expect anything else.
Huh? So, basically... this situation made[n]no difference. We're nothing to each[n]other.
...Really? I think we would have gotten[n]along better. Actually, it's not too late...
I see. In that case, would it have been[n]better if we had never met?
You obviously missed on purpose. I guess[n]that means you really do like me after all,[n]huh?
I'm not confusing you with this imaginary[n]scenario, am I?
Is this your way of saying that it was[n]a mistake that we ever met?
At least our meeting here and now has[n]some significance...
Ah, what am I going to do? Because we[n]were fighting and everything, I lost track[n]of time.
Well, I need to see myself home soon...
Go home then.
What do you mean?
Let's go home together.
What are you saying? Wait, you aren't[n]being serious, are you?
Oh yeah, do you have school tomorrow?
Well, you know, I'm free tomorrow...[n]Ah, never mind.
Huh. I guess I'm sorry for keeping you[n]here so late.
Aren't we playing the meanie... I know[n]that you know.
You still don't get what I mean...?
What do I mean? Oh, you'll get it soon[n]enough.
It's no use playing innocent.
I can't, but I appreciate the thought.
That reminds me of back when I was[n]in school...
File that under "things you wish you[n]could've said when you were younger".
I don't know what to do when you take[n]one of my jokes so seriously...
You're fine with hanging out till morning?[n]I guess younger boys have more staying[n]power.
Yeah, let's not just part here. We'll hang[n]out a bit more, and try to finish things off[n]with a bang.
I was trying to be nice to you, you[n]know? You should try being nice to[n]me sometimes, too.
I think I get it. It's not the result, but the[n]process that matters to you.
...Oh, yes. I heard that human women[n]often trick their lovers into meeting[n]their parents.
If your girlfriend asked if you were free[n]to have dinner with "everybody," what[n]would you say?
Sure.
I'm busy.
What are you talking about?
Thank goodness. It's so nice that you're[n]really okay with that... Er, I mean, it's[n]not like this is about me.
Really? It's so nice that you're okay with[n]this on such short notice... Er, I mean,[n]it's not like this is about me.
Thanks. Sorry, I know it's a hassle for[n]you... Er, I mean, it's not like this is[n]about me.
You're just saying that because you're[n]supposed to, huh... It's not like this is[n]about me, but that's rather upsetting.
Busy, huh... So you have something[n]more important than me? I mean,[n]that's what she would say, not me.
I suppose it would be awkward for you[n]to meet my parents right now... I mean,[n]that's what she would say, not me.
But I already told my parents that you[n]were okay with meeting them... I mean,[n]that's what she would say, not me.
Don't think you can get away with that[n]flimsy excuse. I won't— I mean, she[n]wouldn't allow that.
...I guess it IS a little too early for you.
Huh? That was just a hypothetical[n]situation of... er, my fantasies...
There was once a time in my life[n]when I wanted to say a line like that.
You're going to play dumb? ...I don't see[n]a future with you.
Oh, you were already coming to pay[n]your respects to my parents, anyway?[n]That makes me so happy.
It's better to get the formalities out of[n]the way early. Trust me.
Oh, come on. Would it kill you to just[n]play along with me a little bit longer?
Do you not care about meeting your[n]partner's parents? They might end up[n]becoming family, you know.
...When human women take a vacation,[n]they go on trips with their boyfriends,[n]right?
I wanted to go on vacation, too, before[n]all this happened...
That's too bad.
What are you getting at?
You have a boyfriend?
Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to go on a rant.
This is all your fault, you know...
...You're just spouting empty words[n]because you don't care about me,[n]aren't you?
Well, I don't care about the trip. I just[n]wanted something to brag about.
I don't really know, either.
Hey, I'd be fine if you took me[n]somewhere...
...Oh? Are you being considerate?
...Take a hint, would you?
Well, it's not like you're my actual[n]soulmate...
Oh, you're interested in that...?
...What is that supposed to mean?
No I don't! Happy you made me say[n]that...?
Ah, right, it is a western style bridal fair,[n]huh? I understand. I'll consider Japanese[n]style, too.
What if I told you there's a good Thai[n]restaurant near the bridal fair? See,[n]going there won't be so bad.
Please. Please just play along with me a[n]little bit longer...
Sorry... I guess the conversation[n]suddenly got... really heavy there,[n]didn't it?
...Oh yes. I'm sorry to ask at a time like[n]this, but I'm interested in men's home[n]cooking.
Do you have a dish you're good at?
Fried rice.
Mystery meat.
What are you saying?
So you're good at cooking rice that way,[n]huh? Yeah, that sounds like something a[n]guy would make.
...I dunno about that. I'm trying to stay[n]away from oily foods.
What? You can make that with leftovers[n]in the fridge. Why don't you make me[n]something else?
Like kimchi fried rice? That always[n]tastes best when the kimchi makes[n]it look bright red.
...That's the first time I've ever heard of[n]someone specializing in mystery meat.
So... How do you make it? I'm genuinely[n]intrigued.
Are you saying that just to see how I[n]react?
Coming up with weird ingredients is[n]actually a lot of work...
Ah, I see now. Cooking really is kind of[n]a hassle, huh?
...You're no fun. Join the conversation[n]a little.
It's fine. It's not about the taste, but[n]the thought.
Ah, sorry. I guess you must be really[n]self-conscious about your cooking[n]skills, huh?
Oh, don't worry. If you cook, then I'll[n]do the dishes.
Oh, don't worry. I'm sure you'll be able[n]to cook something nice if you really try.
Quit it. Let me have this little daydream,[n]instead of looking at reality as it really is.
What was that for? You think cooking's[n]a woman's job? That idea's pretty[n]outdated, you know.
I can't believe that I got led around this[n]far by a man.
Is there a reason why I just can't beat[n]you?
I'm younger, that's all.
I've totally got girl power.
Figure it out yourself.
...I don't have a comeback to that.
Well yeah, I can see that myself.
You've got some nerve to say that to[n]my face...
Yeah? I guess being young is kind of a[n]weapon in itself when I really think[n]about it...
*giggle* Tell me more about this girl[n]power that you managed to overcome[n]me with.
Isn't it rare for a man to have so much[n]girl power? Well, I guess it's also not[n]impossible.
Are you sure you know what that means?
What? How could I possibly lose to you[n]in girl power?
Oh, quit teasing me. I don't have time[n]to just guess the answer.
...Ugh, I don't feel like listening to a[n]sermon from someone younger than me.
I guess you're right. Besides, I decided[n]that I shouldn't always be depending[n]on men.
...I see now. I guess you got this far by[n]having the strength to think and depend[n]on yourself...
So you're telling me... You won because[n]I'm too naïve and warm-hearted?
You're right. This isn't a situation where[n]we can just talk about things like that.
I'm getting mixed messages here. Are[n]you encouraging me or saying I'll never[n]be as strong as you?
So you can't even be bothered to chat[n]with me a little? Well, I guess that's that.
This is a bit sudden, but can I talk about[n]something I heard about humans?
What do you think about humans[n]showing pictures of their baby to others?
It's cute.
I'm not interested.
What are you talking about?
Well, it IS a baby. I guess that's the[n]typical reaction.
Well, I guess it's okay since the other[n]person has no duty to raise that child.
You think? The baby may be cute, but[n]what if the parents aren't?
Well, I suppose you have to say that,[n]or people will get angry...
You're not? I like it; it feels like you're[n]sharing their happiness.
Maybe you'll see things differently[n]when you have a child.
I can attest to that! It's like forcing[n]your happiness on others!
Then what ARE you interested in?
...This is true.
...Oh, this is only the beginning of my[n]conversation.
...It's not like I'm being jealous of the[n]happiness of others...
That I'm not jealous at all!
I see now. Being jealous of other[n]people's happiness won't make you[n]happy. Is that what you mean?
You don't waste much time on idle talk.[n]I'm guessing you're good at keeping[n]secrets.
This is who I am. Sorry to disappoint.
What? You don't feel like listening to[n]me talk, huh?
...I know now's not the time for this,[n]but I think you're actually my type.
How about we live together? What kind[n]of place do you want to live in?
